name: Nanase
source:
Yandere neighbor of Seijuro. She looks like a good and kind girl at first sight, but it seems that she has taken some drastic and rather extreme measures during the time Seijuro was in a coma. Hopefully, Seijuro won't mind about those measures too much. After all, they were implemented only for his own good... or at least that's what Nanase would like him to believe.

[Edited from [url=https://www.nutaku.net/games/download/my-neighbor-is-a-yandere/]Nutaku[/url]]
